'''Erep''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Naboo (star)/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]],<ref name="SN" /><ref name="EA" /> located in the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]]<ref name="Region" /> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] Territories.<ref name="EAOC" /> Erep was a [[Temperature/Legends|searing]] rock with one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="SN" /><ref name="EA" /> By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Erep had no known [[City/Legends|settlements]].<ref name="SN" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]], except [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], were first introduced in ''[[Secrets of Naboo]]'', a [[2001]] supplement for the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SN" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Naboo star system in grid square O-17.<ref name="EA" />
